recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 淋巴組織：中央為小淋巴球環繞、稍淡染的結節狀區域，左上方有粉紅色、帶裂隙狀管腔的血管或上皮結構，周圍混有較大淡染細胞；細胞無明顯異型，屬正常淋巴組織，但單憑此圖無法確定確切部位。
features: Lymphoid parenchyma composed predominantly of small round lymphocytes
Vaguely nodular aggregate with a slightly paler central zone of mixed larger cells
Eosinophilic structures with slit-like lumens at the upper left (vessels or epithelial elements)
Interspersed pale histiocytoid cells in surrounding areas
No cytologic atypia or sheets of large cells; resolution limits fine detail
describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue at intermediate magnification shows predominantly small round lymphocytes forming a vaguely nodular aggregate with a paler central zone, adjacent to eosinophilic structures with slit-like lumens representing vessels or epithelial elements. Scattered paler histiocytoid cells are present, and there is no cytologic atypia or sheet-like proliferation of large cells. The exact anatomic site cannot be determined from this field alone. Findings are consistent with normal lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are crowded and uniform without polarization or tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-positive in germinal center cells.
SLL diffusely effaces architecture with pale proliferation centers of prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts rather than preserved compartments.
Would show a keratin-positive epithelial meshwork with immature TdT-positive T cells and lobulation by fibrous septa.
